system_description.narrative_title: Global bond rout and surging yields
system_description.narrative_summary: A sustained sell-off in government bonds has driven yields to multi‑decade highs, reshaping investor positioning and raising borrowing costs across markets. This open system features feedback loops between sovereign debt supply, interest-rate expectations, central-bank action, and investor risk behavior that propagate shocks into housing, banks, currencies, and alternative assets. Fiscal stress and central‑bank communication interact with market liquidity and leveraged strategies, producing volatility and sporadic reversals as participants rebalance.
system_description.scope: Developed-market government bond markets (US Treasuries, UK gilts, French OATs, Japan), yield and price dynamics, interest-rate expectations, central-bank signals, investor positioning (hedge funds, retail, institutional), credit and mortgage markets, currency and safe-haven flows.
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial system (global economy, cross-border capital flows, monetary and fiscal regimes)
adjacent_subsystems: Sovereign fiscal policy and debt management

variables.name: Nominal government bond yield level
variables.description: Average market yield on long‑term government bonds across the developed‑market bond complex.

variables.name: Term premium
variables.description: Additional yield investors require to hold longer‑maturity bonds versus short‑term instruments.

variables.name: Interest‑rate expectations
variables.description: Market‑implied expected path of short‑ and medium‑term policy rates and forward rates.

variables.name: Monetary policy signaling
variables.description: Strength and directional bias of forward guidance and policy signalling as interpreted by markets.

variables.name: Government debt supply rate
variables.description: Pace at which new government fixed‑income securities are issued into the market over time.

variables.name: Fiscal stress level
variables.description: Market‑assessed pressure from public fiscal positions, including deficit and debt burden dynamics.

variables.name: Market liquidity depth
variables.description: Ease with which large bond positions can be transacted without causing large price dislocations.

variables.name: Investor leverage ratio
variables.description: Average degree of borrowed exposure used by market participants in fixed‑income and related strategies.

variables.name: Leverage unwind rate
variables.description: Speed at which leveraged positions are reduced or liquidated across the system.

variables.name: Investor risk aversion level
variables.description: Aggregate appetite for risk versus safe assets among market participants.

variables.name: Safe‑haven asset demand
variables.description: Net flow or demand pressure into perceived safe‑haven assets and currencies during stress periods.

variables.name: Credit spread level
variables.description: Average premium demanded on non‑government credit relative to risk‑free yields across maturities.

variables.name: Mortgage borrowing cost
variables.description: Typical interest rate level and financing cost for household mortgage borrowing.

variables.name: Housing affordability
variables.description: Ratio of housing purchase and carrying costs to median household income and financing availability.

variables.name: Portfolio rebalancing rate
variables.description: Speed and magnitude at which investors shift allocations across bonds, equities, cash, and alternatives.

variables.name: Market volatility level
variables.description: Realized and implied volatility in bond and related financial markets reflecting price dispersion over time.

catalysts.title: FOMC minutes release
catalysts.description: Publication of recent Fed minutes that could clarify near‑term policy stance and reshape market pricing around hikes or pauses.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Week Ahead for FX, Bonds: Fed Minutes in Focus...' and Fed pause signals; minutes will move market pricing.

catalysts.title: December FOMC meeting / possible rate move
catalysts.description: Markets price a potential Fed rate action in December, which could materially lift rate expectations and long yields if enacted.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Fed may skip October but pull rate hike trigger in December' — December decision could push yields higher.

catalysts.title: Resumption/continuation of U.S. Treasury sell‑off
catalysts.description: Ongoing renewed selling pressure in U.S. Treasuries that can push yields higher, widen term premium, and increase volatility.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. Treasury Selloff Resumes After Brief Respite', 'Global bond rout deepens'.

catalysts.title: French sovereign spread widening / eurozone fiscal jitters
catalysts.description: Continued investor concern over French (and other EMU) fiscal positions driving spread widening and safe‑haven flows within Europe.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'France Is Ground Zero in the Global Bond Rout', 'French Yield Spreads Jump on Fiscal Worries'.

catalysts.title: Sustained US dollar strength
catalysts.description: Continued dollar appreciation on prospects of higher U.S. rates that shifts global flows and affects safe‑haven dynamics and commodity prices.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Dollar Hits Near 18-Month High on Prospect of Higher U.S. Rates' and impacts cited across coverage.

catalysts.title: Elevated mortgage rates and affordability squeeze
catalysts.description: Persistent high mortgage rates that raise borrowing costs and materially worsen housing affordability, feeding into consumption and market rebalancing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'US mortgage rates jump... largest weekly gain', 'High mortgage rates are trapping homeowners'.

catalysts.title: Hawkish Fed official rhetoric
catalysts.description: Comments from influential Fed officials calling for larger hikes could re‑anchor market expectations and lift yields even absent immediate policy moves.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Fed's Logan calls for "50 bps or more"' and other officials debating timing of hikes.

catalysts.title: Rising gilt yields and UK budget jitters
catalysts.description: Continued upward pressure on UK gilt yields amid budget concerns that can provoke bank stress and wider market volatility in Europe.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'UK banks tumble as gilt yields hit highest since 1998, budget jitters mount' and related coverage.
